plate_havoc_content:card.critical_rollba: Blocks damage that would've killed regardless of health (Max: 2).

to Boost (Goes backwards. Hold to increase power (+4%% per tick, capped to 300%%)). Shooting affects only hostiles.

plate_havoc_content:card.mechanical_hear: Being under 20%% health removes an additional tick from the Cycle time and Clock spawn time on odd ticks (Stackable).
plate_havoc_content:card.blood_money.des: Melee hits yield Cyclathrons from damage dealt to an entity. Accumulated damage permanently increases Attack damage up to +2.5 max.
plate_havoc_content:card.midas_touch.des: Usage of an Artefact increases Cyclathron yield by 0.1 for the cycle.
plate_havoc_content:card.gashed_tissue.d: Taking damage yields Cyclathrons, scaled by Max health.
plate_havoc_content:card.nanomachines.de: Receiving 8 or more hearts of damage over 1.5 seconds doubles Armour for 8 seconds. Can be stacked for a longer duration.

plate_havoc:tutorial.introductory: A roguelite plate game based around surviving random events.
plate_havoc:tutorial.main:
Survive events that raise the Intensity (🔥), becoming increasingly severe.

Collect Clocks to deduct Time (⏳), the primary goal for the next Cycle.

Cyclathrons (€) is a shared currency from Clocks or means for purchasing Cards.

Cards can be beneficial, harmful or both (Upgrades & Curses).

Survivors have unique abilities, different style and stats.

There are several vanilla changes (0.5x Air drag and lessened Breaking & Building).
plate_havoc:tutorial.end: For Modrinth people, this is a more polished version of the classic game with modern changes and additions from phase 1 of Splintered Worlds. The Discord link is found on the page.
